annotations.text: League builder — revision round applied. Two app headers everywhere: the global my151.app header (Tools menu hosts cross-tool nav) and the tool banner (counter · progress runway · controls), then a scrollable h1. Stage glyphs now live inside the grid, in the rightmost empty cell, template-style; gym 1 carries a No badges label; champion = filled crown, endgame boss = red pokeball. Spacer bands introduce the champion and boss rows. The signature panel fills the top-left 3×4 void, like the /vp/ template.
League home = a zoomed-out card: same 7-column grid plus a type column, 14 rows, glyphs hugging each team. E4 slots show 1–4 stars; dashed tiles mark the add points. Rows drag to reorder.

The card. Signature panel spans 3 columns × 4 rows from A1; glyphs sit in the rightmost empty cell; CHAMPION TEAM and ENDGAME BOSS TEAM bands mirror the /vp/ template. M/D corner buttons on Gyarados/Lapras; Suicune (crown badge) is the boss-row legend swap.

The dex builder's selection pane, reused as-is (same search bar, result count, chip styles, 6-column evo-line grid, gen badges). Type: Water pre-selected from the card; the filter row dims while a search runs, exactly like the dex builder. One line card per branch.
Desktop: both panes updated to the new structures — open card left, league right, active row fans out. The picker overlays the league pane when open.
